# Comparative Annual Financial Review and Outlook Analysis for NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel

**Insufficient evidence**

NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel reported contrasting annual performance trajectories up to the outcome cutoff of March 1, 2025 [Eaf78097930](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html) [E7f0d407567](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html) [E0a7a8b131a](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html). NVIDIA demonstrated substantial revenue and operating income expansion, whereas Intel encountered sharp operating losses [Eaf78097930](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html) [E63b9df5055](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html). Qualitative outlook statements regarding future expenditures and segment drivers lacked quantitative precision, rendering them untestable as specific numerical targets [E6d99df9c0b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm) [E3c240cf3fc](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086324000149/intc-20240928.htm).

## Numbers on record

NVDA revenue for the fiscal period ended 2026-01-25 was $215.938 billion [E1ee42e5595](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000021/0001045810-26-000021-index.html), up from $130.497 billion for 2025-01-26 [Eaf78097930](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html). NVDA net income for the fiscal period ended 2026-01-25 was $120.067 billion [Eef3b5c67c4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000021/0001045810-26-000021-index.html), up from $72.880 billion for 2025-01-26 [E3e123cecb5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of the 2025 viewpoint through March 1, 2025, NVIDIA filed its annual report for the period ending January 26, 2025, on February 26, 2025, reporting annual revenue of $130,497,000,000 and operating income of $81,453,000,000 [Eaf78097930](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html) [Ed26891b1f6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html). AMD filed its annual report for the period ending December 28, 2024, on February 5, 2025, reporting annual revenue of $25,785,000,000 and operating income of $1,900,000,000 [E7f0d407567](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html) [Ebc212f1281](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html). Intel filed its annual report for the period ending December 28, 2024, on January 31, 2025, reporting annual revenue of $53,101,000,000 and an operating loss of $11,678,000,000 [E0a7a8b131a](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html) [E63b9df5055](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html).

## What happened later

Subsequent filings extending past the 2025 viewpoint show that for the fiscal period ending January 25, 2026, NVIDIA reported annual revenue of $215,938,000,000 and operating income of $130,387,000,000 filed on February 25, 2026 [E1ee42e5595](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000021/0001045810-26-000021-index.html) [Effb397ce53](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000021/0001045810-26-000021-index.html). For the period ending December 27, 2025, AMD reported annual revenue of $34,639,000,000 and operating income of $3,694,000,000 filed on February 4, 2026 [E99f77b20a8](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000018/0000002488-26-000018-index.html) [E9981b97b1c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000018/0000002488-26-000018-index.html). For the period ending December 27, 2025, Intel reported annual revenue of $52,853,000,000 and an operating loss of $2,214,000,000 filed on January 23, 2026 [E523c845704](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086326000011/0000050863-26-000011-index.html) [E48a74e5f9f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086326000011/0000050863-26-000011-index.html).

## The peer test

Comparing the latest annual periods available through the outcome cutoff, NVIDIA's fiscal year ended on 2025-01-26 with $130,497,000,000 in revenue and $81,453,000,000 in operating income [Eaf78097930](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html) [Ed26891b1f6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html). AMD's fiscal year ended on 2024-12-28 with $25,785,000,000 in revenue and $1,900,000,000 in operating income [E7f0d407567](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html) [Ebc212f1281](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html). Intel's fiscal year ended on 2024-12-28 with $53,101,000,000 in revenue and an operating loss of $11,678,000,000 [E0a7a8b131a](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html) [E63b9df5055](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html). Differing fiscal calendars (such as NVIDIA's retail-style shifting 52-53 week year ending in late January versus traditional late-December calendar ends for AMD and Intel) cause slight date mismatches, though all cover annual performance spanning 2024 into early 2025.

## Cross-examination

Management disclosures from the 2025 viewpoint contained qualitative or directional statements without explicit numeric targets for consolidated annual revenue or operating income, rendering them untestable as precise promises [E6d99df9c0b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm) [E3c240cf3fc](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086324000149/intc-20240928.htm). For instance, NVIDIA's expectation of higher capital expenditures and Intel's restructuring-based cost reduction expectations describe qualitative operational plans rather than measurable financial guarantees [E6d99df9c0b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm) [E3c240cf3fc](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086324000149/intc-20240928.htm). Matching subsequent revenue expansion in peers does not mathematically verify qualitative spending forecasts or unobservable funding sources [E6d99df9c0b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm).

## Limits

- As-of vintage macro data for the 2025 viewpoint is missing.
- Specific management guidance metrics for annual revenue and operating income were absent in the analyzed filings.
- The financial comparison may be informative, but no retrieved management claim was linked to testable outcomes. The overall claim verdict is therefore insufficient evidence.
